description: A column projected through a derived table, CTE, view, LATERAL, join or set operation keeps its SOURCE type, so a compile-time rejection cannot be bypassed by wrapping the query one level down: FILE GROUP BY keys and MAX over OBJECT/ARRAY refuse with the identical live message through every wrapper (star projections, aliases, ANSI derived-column lists, CTE column lists, two and three nesting levels, recursive-CTE anchors, expression projections, VECTOR dimensions); agreeing set-operation branches keep the shared type while disagreeing ones unify to the non-string side; and the bound holds - VARIANT stays VARIANT (accepted by ordering aggregates), table-function columns stay undetermined and accepted, ordinary types still group/sort/aggregate, a FILE still counts, and a derived column's known type is the RIGHT type (a derived DATE takes temporal functions, a derived BOOLEAN conditions, a derived NUMBER does not). Converted 1:1 from expressions/DerivedColumnStaticTypeTest (now retired).
